zones.name: Mate y pala
zones.prompt: Playful, upbeat digging-with-a-shovel theme. Plucky chiptune lead, snappy drums, cheerful and fast, about 120 bpm.

zones.name: Cumbia del cantero
zones.prompt: Argentine cumbia meets chiptune: güiro, cumbia drum groove, accordion-like synth lead, festive birthday party vibe, about 100 bpm.

zones.name: Globos y confites
zones.prompt: Happy, bouncy birthday-party digging tune: cheerful chiptune lead with a whistle-like melody, hand claps, bright marimba and a bouncy bass, sunny and carefree, about 112 bpm.

zones.name: Cuevas de cristal
zones.prompt: Mysterious but cozy underground crystal cave exploration. Glassy chimes, soft arpeggios, echoing triangle-wave melody, about 88 bpm.

zones.name: Eco del granito
zones.prompt: Adventurous mining theme deeper underground. Steady drums, echoing synth melody, a little tension and a lot of wonder, about 100 bpm.

zones.name: Minero de medianoche
zones.prompt: Laid-back midnight miner groove. Plucked synth lead, warm round bass, relaxed lo-fi retro game feel, about 92 bpm.

zones.name: Abismo
zones.prompt: Deep underground abyss theme with a clear, memorable melody right up front: bright bell-like lead and warm synth pads over a steady mid-tempo beat and a deep, punchy bass. Mysterious and vast but full, loud and present the whole time, never quiet, sparse or ambient, about 92 bpm.

zones.name: Corazón de la tierra
zones.prompt: Glowing lava caverns near the center of the Earth. Rising tension, triangle-wave arpeggios, mysterious melody, about 96 bpm.

zones.name: Latido de magma
zones.prompt: Magma chamber with a heartbeat drum pulse, ominous choir pads and a slow building tension, about 84 bpm.

zones.name: Combate final
zones.prompt: Epic final boss battle against a wizard eagle that keeps evolving: a big opening hit, galloping drums and a heroic synth-brass lead with a catchy main theme; then a contrasting section with choir and a key change, call-and-response between the lead and fast arpeggios, a short breakdown and a build to a huge climax. Very dynamic and varied, never monotonous or repetitive, about 150 bpm.

zones.name: Lluvia de magma
zones.prompt: Frantic boss fight while fire rains from above. Driving drums, gritty saw-wave leads, heroic and urgent, about 160 bpm.

zones.name: Furia de Aguilus
zones.prompt: Dramatic, slightly comedic villain boss theme. Organ and choir over chiptune drums, epic and theatrical, about 144 bpm.

zones.name: Nota misteriosa
zones.prompt: Storybook intro with a playful mystery twist: pizzicato strings, soft bells and a curious chiptune melody, light tiptoeing percussion, whimsical and a little suspenseful, about 96 bpm.

zones.name: A buscar los regalos
zones.prompt: Tense but upbeat get-ready-for-action theme: driving staccato strings and punchy drums, bold heroic brass-like synth hits and a determined chiptune melody, rising energy like heroes preparing for a mission. Exciting and adventurous, never dark, scary or gloomy, about 128 bpm.

zones.name: Patio soleado
zones.prompt: Cheerful sunny backyard on a birthday morning. Bright square-wave lead, bouncy bass, light drums, catchy major-key melody, about 104 bpm.

backup.name: Cumple en el barrio
backup.prompt: Warm, gentle opening theme for a birthday morning in a sunny Buenos Aires neighborhood: music box and soft chiptune lead, light acoustic guitar and soft percussion, nostalgic, sweet and cozy, about 90 bpm.

backup.name: Rumbo a los regalos
backup.prompt: Hopeful adventure-begins theme: bright chiptune melody over soft strings and gentle drums, steadily building warmth and excitement, cheerful and cinematic, about 100 bpm.
